thread:
Alex: Quick sync — recurring incident patterns review. I pulled the last 6 months of postmortems and grouped by root cause. We need owners + short timelines for the top 4 themes before the exec sync next Tuesday. Can we assign? :calendar:
Sandeep: I can take 'KV cache thrash' — we've seen it in 4 incidents (cache invalidation + multi-tenant churn). I'll propose mitigation by end of next week.
Ria: I'll own 'autoscale cold-start spikes' — I've got a WIP plan to warm pools and adjust cooldowns, target PR by Thu.
Mike: I'll pick 'high-latency RPC retries' — mostly networking/config mix. Need to run a traffictest this week, ETA 10 days.
Priya: I'll take 'OOMs on quantized variants' — looks like a model-quant mismatch in 2 tenants. I'll try repro and add guardrails, aiming for EOD Friday.
Alex: Awesome. Can each of you paste a 1-line acceptance criteria and a delivery date reply below so we can track in the postmortem follow-up doc? I'll consolidate and create ownership rows. :thumbsup:
Sandeep: Acceptance: reduce cache-invalid-triggered incidents by 80% under median workload. Delivery: 2026-04-10.
Ria: Acceptance: cold-start rate <= 1% under baseline QPS and warm pool hit >= 90%. Delivery: 2026-04-08.
Mike: Acceptance: end-to-end RPC p95 latency down by 35% for affected path; retries fail closed for timed-out flows. Delivery: 2026-04-18.
Priya: Acceptance: reproduce OOM locally and add runtime guard to reject/migrate requests for incompatible quant profiles; Delivery: 2026-04-03.
Alex: I'll add these as action items in the tracking doc and set weekly check-ins. Also: which of these need infra support (capacity, kernel flags, priority queues)?
Sandeep: Need a small infra change (prefix cache metric export + expose per-tenant invalidation counts). Tagging OncallBot to create a ticket for infra.
OncallBot: New ticket created: INFRA-2982 "cache invalidation metrics + per-tenant counts" assigned to eng-infra. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-2982
Ria: We need a burst pool for warmups, may need an approval for reserved GPUs for testing. I'll file a request to infra by EOD.
Mike: Might need network team to permit synthetic traffic pattern for 2 hours. I'll coordinate with netops and post the time window here once scheduled.
Priya: No infra changes required initially, but I'll flag if we need a patched runtime.
Alex: Two more asks: 1) please add a small regression test (postmortem repro) to your PRs; 2) add the issue ID for the postmortem this action comes from so we can close the follow-up in the tracker automatically.
Sandeep: Will add test + PMT-2026 link.
Ria: Added test plan to the PR template, will include PMT-2042.
Mike: PR will reference PMT-2019.
Priya: Reference PMT-2033 in my branch.
Alex: Thanks. I'll create a tracking row for each with columns: owner, theme, acceptance, delivery, infra-dep, postmortem-id, status. I'll post the doc link here after creation.
Alex: Draft tracking doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/ops/incident-patterns-tracker — sharing in case you want to prefill.
Sandeep: Quick Q: Do we want to treat 'repeat offenders' tenants differently (transfer-to-dedicated capacity)? I can list top 3 tenants to discuss.
Ria: Yes, we should. Add a column for 'tenant mitigation' and recommend follow-up with CS.
Mike: Agreed. Also propose we add a monthly heatmap in the docs that shows frequency by theme + tenant. I'll take on the initial viz.
Priya: If anyone needs me to pair on repros for OOMs, ping me. I have a local quant test harness.
Alex: Great. Action items recap in-thread:
- Sandeep: KV cache thrash — acceptance + delivery 2026-04-10 — INFRA ticket created (INFRA-2982) — add PMT-2026.
- Ria: Autoscale cold-starts — delivery 2026-04-08 — file infra reserved GPU request — PMT-2042.
- Mike: RPC retries/latency — delivery 2026-04-18 — coordinate netops window — PMT-2019.
- Priya: OOMs quant variants — delivery 2026-04-03 — repro + guardrail — PMT-2033.
Alex: I'll run the weekly status ping on Fridays. If something slips, escalate to ops-manager. Closing loop: please update the tracker when PRs are open so we can mark status as 'in review'. :eyes:
Sandeep: Updated the tracker row (link in doc).
Ria: Filed the reserved-GPU request and linked it in the doc.
Mike: Scheduled the trafictest for 2026-03-31 14:00 UTC, posted to #netops.
Priya: Opened WIP branch with repro steps, link in doc.
Alex: Thanks all — I'll rerun the pattern scan after your deliveries and prepare a short executive slide for next Tue that highlights progress versus last quarter.
Sandeep: One last note — let's tag any long-running follow-ups as recurring if they cross quarters, so PM can budget.
Alex: Agreed. Will add 'recurring' flag column.
Ria: +1 :thumbsup:
OncallBot: Reminder scheduled: weekly check-in every Fri 16:00 UTC for this thread.
Alex: That should keep us honest. Thanks everyone.
